fixed_model.name: ORDERED_FIRST_ORDER_LEAST_FIXED_POINT_LOGIC
aliases: FP on linearly ordered finite structures
fixed_model.input_model: finite relational encoding of 3-CNF equipped with the presented linear order from its string/relational encoding

theorem_used.name: IMMERMAN_VARDI_THEOREM
theorem_used.statement: Over linearly ordered finite structures, fixed-point logic captures deterministic polynomial time: a property is FP-definable iff it is decidable in PTIME.
sources: Neil Immerman, Relational queries computable in polynomial time, Information and Control 68 (1986)
Moshe Y. Vardi, The complexity of relational query languages, STOC 1982

TRUMP_characterization.statement: For standard ordered encodings of 3-CNF, 3SAT is definable in ordered fixed-point logic iff 3SAT is in deterministic polynomial time, equivalently iff P=NP.
forward: Evaluation of a fixed FP sentence on an ordered finite structure is polynomial-time.
Therefore an ordered-FP definition of 3SAT yields 3SAT in P.
Because 3SAT is NP-complete under polynomial-time reductions, 3SAT in P implies P=NP.
reverse: If P=NP then 3SAT is in P.
By Immerman-Vardi, every PTIME property of ordered finite structures is definable in FP.

derived_TRUMP_consequence.claim: Adding the ordinary presented input order is a legitimate escape from the unordered FPC barrier, but once the transition model is strong enough to range over all ordered fixed-point/PTIME computations, proving that it decides arbitrary 3SAT is exactly the final P=NP task rather than a weaker intermediate theorem.

dead_zone_mapping.meaning: Supplying an order removes the symmetry limitation of unordered FPC, but the resulting model already spans PTIME; deciding 3SAT there is exactly the original complexity-class frontier.

next_admissible_math.question: Instead of naming another generic PTIME-complete computation formalism, can TRUMP state one concrete deterministic ordered-input transition law and prove a nontrivial invariant that forces exact progress in polynomial charged work on every 3CNF?
forbidden: repackaging all of PTIME as a new mechanism
assuming the final P=NP claim inside the transition invariant
